# balatro-headless

> Balatro's own game code (1.0.1o), run headless from the user's own install; a learned policy trained on it that sees only what a player sees; and a record of every seed it has beaten, each with a route that replays move for move to the game's own win.

Important for anyone reading or using this repository:

- Balatro was created by LocalThunk and is published by Playstack. This repository contains none of the game. The harness reads the game from the user's own purchased install. The MIT license covers this project's tooling only.
- Nothing in the game is reimplemented. The harness boots the game's own Lua in LuaJIT 2.0.5 (the game's runtime; some random draws depend on its table order) via lupa, with LÖVE stubbed out, and was checked decision by decision against runs logged in the real game.
- Results are simulator runs of the game's own code, not real-save achievements.
- A seed counts as beaten only if its saved route replays move for move to the game's own win (the Ante 8 boss beaten).
- **Current policy: v6g best.pt (round 660)**, sha256 4462f80e4b41fb9e85ec9f69a48dc3bf1ac35099d3c3a6f3213b8535aa909106. Trained on the Red Deck only: imitation of Balatro Lab's hand-built bot (v6e, v6dt), then PPO on "blinds beaten" at Gold Stake (v6g). Zero-shot, it has won at Gold Stake on all 15 decks; t0 win rates 0.01-0.32% per deck over 9,000 seeds (Black 18,000); 114 routes verified. White Stake, Red Deck: 174/600.
- Training next: v6gd, v6g's run with every game's deck drawn uniformly from all 15 (registered 2026-11-25, `docs/runs/v6gd.md`).
- Wins cluster on a shared band of about 1% of seeds; deck strength sets the rate inside it.
- Prior art: AnteZero (namecallfilter/antezero) reports about 12% at Gold over all 15 decks with a policy trained on every deck and stake, released before this result. Atol8/balatro-ai (LLM with tools) won Black Deck Gold Stake in the real game. Balatro Lab (KvashaIhor/balatro-lab) is the teacher.
- Designs and predictions are committed before their code or data (`docs/hypotheses-v6.md`); committed sections are never edited; results, including predictions not met, are new sections.
- Earlier runs (models 0.1-1.0, moe2, v4-v6 arms), their docs and weights are kept at git tags listed in `ARCHIVE.md`.

## Code

- `harness/`: game runtime, legal actions, observations, replay.
- `train/`: trainer (`train.py`), imitation (`imitate.py`), launcher (`launch.py`), publishing and replay checks (`publish_wins.py`, `verify_games.py`).
- `tools/eval_ladder.py`: evaluate any checkpoint on any deck and stake; `tools/ladder_to_routes.py`: turn its wins into verified routes.
- `gold/`: the 15-deck Gold checks.
